question_and_gold.question: Consider the highest peak in the Northern Calcareous Alps. What is the result of adding the quotient of its elevation (in meters) and the duration (in millions of years) of the Norian stage, to the product of the duration (in millions of years) of the Rhaetian stage and the number of known specimens of the genus Caviramus, and then subtracting the year the genus Carniadactylus was named from this sum?
